selection_policy.decision_rule: Select the highest weighted score that advances the source-backed knowledge base without requiring ambiguous evidence resolution, unavailable exact source relationships or a destructive operation.

repository_readiness.missing_layer: deterministic extraction candidates separated from approved imports

candidates.name: PDF Candidate Extraction Automation Review
candidates.decision: Review a deterministic candidate-only extraction layer for registered PDFs. The repository already has pinned local sources, page-aware evidence review, a CI text backend and declarative importers, but extraction output must remain separate from approved master-data imports.

candidates.name: Workflow Maintainability Review
candidates.decision: Review standard workflow duplication, runtime and failure diagnostics after the recent workspace package. The current fifteen-workflow baseline is green, so this is valuable operational follow-up rather than the highest-value knowledge-base package.

candidates.name: External Data Product Format Review
candidates.decision: Review whether an additional stable external format would add value beyond the existing JSON, Markdown, CSV, HTML and XLSX products. The current portfolio is already public and usable, reducing urgency.

candidates.name: Exact Configuration Expansion Review
candidates.decision: Do not create configurations or project generic observations without exact source-backed configurations and relationships.

candidates.name: Spring Source Foundation Review
candidates.decision: Keep Spring as a strategic expansion target until an exact current source and approved configuration scope are registered.

selection.name: PDF Candidate Extraction Automation Review
selection.rationale: The two previously higher-priority consumer milestones—public cross-model delivery and local workspace discoverability—are complete. Five official brochures are pinned locally with exact identities and mature evidence boundaries, while CI and the unified CLI already provide the adjacent extraction, review and import building blocks. A review can now select the smallest safe candidate-only automation without changing source data or approving imports.

architectures_to_compare: rule-based scalar and range candidate extraction
table-region candidate extraction with explicit review
hybrid candidate queue that separates text pages from visual diagrams

next_package.name: PDF Candidate Extraction Automation Review
next_package.goal: Inventory the registered PDF sources and existing extraction, review and import tooling; compare candidate-only architectures; and select the smallest deterministic pipeline that preserves page-level provenance and evidence boundaries without modifying master data or producing approved imports.
